etymarab.kok_maddesi: Back to library EtymArab QYRṬ قيرط BP – • HDAL • © SG | 15Oct2024 √QYRṬ "root" ▪ QYRṬ_1 ‘inch; (a measure); kerat, a weight’ ↗ qīrāṭ ▪ QYRṬ_2 ‘...’ ↗ ... ▪ [v1] : Via Syr qīrāṭā (so Fraenkel1886) or directly (so Vollers1897) from Grk κεράτιον kerátion ‘light weight; carob seed’, according to Rolland2014 »probablement d’origine sémitique«; cf., however, Beekes2009: 676 where κεράτιον is listed as a deriv. from κέρας kéras ‘horn’, thus orig. dimin. ‘little horn’, hence ‘name of a weight and a coin, “carat”’; the pl. κεράτια then also meant ‘fruits of the carob-tree’, hence the n.f. κερατία ~ κερατέα ‘carob-tree’. ▪ … – ▪ … ▪ ↗ qīrāṭ – Sources ; meta ; gram ; engl ; conc ; hist ; cogn ; disc ; west ; deriv ;
